description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrValidator' which is responsible for validating and transforming HTML tag attributes within the HTMLPurifier library. It handles attribute validation, transformation, and cleanup for tokens representing HTML elements during purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating and transforming attributes of HTML tokens.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates and mutates the attributes of a given HTML token based on configuration and context, applying global and local transformations, and removing invalid attributes.
